published.source: PR #81 (re-searched talents, Instrument of Law 2; client 70425: Judgement of Righteousness 42.9%, Champion of the Light 10 / 20 / 30%, Consecration 4.2% a tick; Seal of Righteousness spell power once per the tooltip; Concentration Aura; Human, 2026-10-16)

summary: Retribution to Twist of Light, with Precision 3 from Protection and Divine Strength, Divine Intellect and Improved Seals from Holy. This copy keeps Judgement of the Crusader on the boss for the raid, instead of getting it from another paladin.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -4.5s, Seal of Command at -3s, Seal of the Crusader at -1.5s (replacing Command leaves its Echo for the first swing)
Judgement of the Crusader at the pull (the duty): 161 Holy damage taken for 40s, refreshed by the paladin's own melee hits, so one cast lasts the fight; judged again only if it drops
Consecration on cooldown while mana is at or above 20%
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Command whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Command up, swap to Seal of Righteousness in the last 1.5s before a swing, and back to Command before the next swing (one swap per swing, down to 20% mana); Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 32 spell power and 18 crit rating, and an on-use 140 spell power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
At 180s: twisting is worth 126 DPS, Consecration 109, Holy Strike 99, Hammer of Wrath 29 (measured before client 70425).
Human is best since client 70425 (Ruthless, 2% crit with any weapon), about 2 to 3 ahead of Undead (Touch of the Grave) at 180s.
Only one 2% crit elixir per character. A second one (Mongoose) would add 14.9 DPS.
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the 50% weapon percent per client data. Not yet confirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date. Holding them to their level 30 trend would cost about 1.2%.

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once, per the 70425 tooltip (the proc spell itself has 0). The SoD-style double count (2 x 11%) would be about 46-51 DPS higher. The proc spell's 0 would be about 53-59 lower.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization applies to Holy seal damage (an Era sim choice, the client limits it to Physical). Removing it costs about 11.
Synthetic gear on the hybrid budget, with only the Justice Battlegear 2-piece active.
The raid's Judgement of the Crusader is off, so the debuff comes only from this paladin.
notes: Request: paladin__level_60 with raid debuff judgementOfTheCrusader removed and the level60_crusader_duty rotation.
